title: From text to generated continuation
description: Generation predicts tokens; the application supplies evidence and constraints.
steps: Tokenizer converts request text into model-specific token IDs
Model processes instructions and available context
Decoder selects a next token under configured sampling
New token is appended and generation repeats
Application checks output before presenting it as an answer

title: Private knowledge must be supplied and checked
description: A confident answer without the required source should not become a fact.
steps: User asks for a private leave-policy limit
Prompt contains no authorized current policy
Model produces a plausible number
Application abstains or retrieves evidence rather than endorsing the guess

title: Build a prompt from typed application inputs

steps: Validate document size and permitted source
Assemble task, audience and explicit output contract
Place source text in a clearly identified data section
Call model with versioned prompt and bounded output
Validate result against schema and source evidence

Application exposes no secret-export capability
Output validation detects unsupported or out-of-scope content

title: Request configuration has several independent budgets

steps: Resolve permitted model and capability configuration
Count or estimate input and reserve output budget
Send request with chosen sampling and response settings
Track response, finish reason, usage and latency
Classify success, truncation, throttling or uncertain timeout

title: A partial answer is not a complete typed result

Application reports incomplete result rather than accepting broken data

Inspect or rerank candidates before using their evidence

steps: Query asks about payroll policy

Authenticated question retrieves permitted candidates

Generate cited answer and verify support or abstain

title: A minimal Spring AI request

Application maps validated result or typed failure to the response

No policy evidence was supplied
Service reports unsupported answer or uses a grounded workflow

title: Choose how to consume the same conceptual request

steps: Browser begins receiving a long stream

title: From generated text to trusted application data
description: Parsing is one step before business validation.

Request typed result through supported model or converter
Parse into application DTO
Validate fields, ranges and evidence rules
Accept result or return explicit contract failure

Application checks allowed fields and approval policy
Reject unauthorized approval and keep model output as a proposal

title: Prepare memory for one authorized conversation

Resolve owned conversation identity
Load ordered messages within token budget
Append current request and call model
Persist completed turn under concurrency and retention rules

title: Publish vectors with source identity

Embed using chosen model and dimensionality

Publish generation for authorized queries

Explicitly retire B and C before old evidence remains searchable

title: A production evidence pipeline
description: Each stage leaves evidence for diagnosis and versioned evaluation.
steps: Authenticate request and resolve current document permissions
Rewrite query only under a bounded task policy
Retrieve lexical and vector candidates with source versions
Rerank and pack permitted passages within context budget
Generate, validate citations and answer or abstain

steps: Policy document D8 is revoked

title: Compose context before the model call

Tool calls the authoritative order service
Typed result returns to model for a supported explanation

title: One bounded agent investigation

steps: Create run with deadline, token and tool-call limits

Validate allowed tool and arguments
Execute authorized action and record typed observation

Next proposal repeats the identical search

description: Discovered metadata does not override host or user authority.

title: Coordinate artifacts rather than unbounded conversations

steps: Coordinator defines task, allowed sources and total budget

title: Measure a release against reproducible cases
description: Versioned inputs and scoring rules make comparisons meaningful.
steps: Freeze corpus, prompts, models and evaluation cases
Run deterministic infrastructure checks

Review failures by task and risk slice
Promote only when release criteria and cost limits are met

title: A good overall score can hide a critical defect

steps: New model improves easy public questions

title: Untrusted language stays inside controlled capabilities

steps: Authenticate principal and bound input sizes
Retrieve only currently authorized evidence

Validate resource permission, schema and action policy

title: A private-network fetch is not just a prompt issue

URL parser, allow-list and egress controls reject destination

title: Bound expensive work before starting it

Orchestrator allocates retrieval, model and tool budgets

Validate final outcome and record actual usage

steps: Gateway retries three times

title: One coherent Java and Spring AI learning project

steps: Ingest versioned approved documents into scoped retrieval

Retrieve evidence and optionally call narrow read-only order tool
Generate typed cited answer within run budget
Validate, persist final outcome and evaluate on regression cases

steps: Assistant retrieves an outdated refund policy

Database unique insert commits code to destination mapping
API returns short URL only after commit
A later GET reads the mapping and returns 302 Location

steps: Reader misses cache and reads active mapping version 7
Owner revokes the mapping at version 8

title: Global admission before expensive work

steps: Gateway authenticates customer and resolves route policy
Construct key from customer, route and policy version
Atomic shared-store operation refills and consumes allowance
Allowed request proceeds to backend
Denied request returns 429 with a defensible retry delay

steps: Shared quota store times out
Payment route rejects or uses a tightly bounded local allowance
Public search route may degrade under a local emergency cap
Record degraded decisions so operators can measure exposure

title: Read through a cache-aside path

Read P4 from cache

steps: Reader obtains database price version 10

title: From order event to provider receipt

steps: Post P8 is copied into many inboxes

steps: Receive transfer T4 from wallet A to B for 20000 paise
Validate currency, authorization and sufficient spendable funds
Lock wallets in stable ID order or use equivalent conditional checks
Insert debit and credit entries with transfer T4
Commit and return the durable transfer result

title: The reply is lost after commit
description: Retry returns the original transfer instead of debiting again.
steps: Transaction for T4 commits both ledger entries
Client receives a network timeout
Client repeats T4 with the same payload
Unique transfer identity returns the committed result

title: Commit one Tic-Tac-Toe move
description: Validation occurs before board mutation and outcome detection.
steps: Receive X at row 1 column 1
Check active game, correct turn and empty square
Place X in the accepted position
Check winning lines through the moved square
Record win or draw; otherwise give O the turn

title: A terminal game cannot accept another move
description: The result is part of the authority, not a UI decoration.
steps: X completes the top row
Game records WIN_X
A delayed O request arrives for another empty square
Reject because the game is already terminal

title: Play one deterministic turn
description: The game applies movement policy before resolving a jump.
steps: Current player starts at square 14
Injected dice source returns 3
Movement rule advances to square 17
Board ladder at 17 moves player to 38
Check victory and choose next player

title: Malformed boards can create infinite turns
description: Validate jump chains or restrict the board to one jump per landing.
steps: Ladder connects 17 to 38
A second jump connects 38 back to 17
Recursive resolution repeats forever
Reject cyclic board data or use bounded visited-square detection

title: Book a seat across route segments
description: A seat must be free for every occupied segment in the requested interval.
steps: Choose dated train run R and boarding A to destination C
Translate stops to interval 0 inclusive to 2 exclusive
Check seat 12 on segments A-B and B-C
Atomically reserve both segments for booking B7
Issue ticket with run, seat and boarding information

title: Partial segment allocation is not a ticket
description: Reserve the full requested journey or nothing.
steps: Seat 12 is free on A-B but occupied on B-C
Customer requests A-C
Allocation detects the occupied segment
Reject this seat without retaining A-B accidentally

title: One order can create multiple shipments
description: Ordered quantities are partitioned across fulfilment outcomes.
steps: Accept order O8 with book and charger price snapshots
Reserve each line's inventory
Create shipment S1 for book and S2 for charger
Record shipped quantities independently
Derive partially shipped or completed order status

title: Cancellation races with dispatch
description: A line cannot be both newly cancelled and dispatched for the same units.
steps: Customer cancels charger quantity 1
Warehouse simultaneously confirms dispatch
One transition records ownership of the remaining quantity
Losing command becomes reject or return workflow, not silent overwrite

title: Book a room for one occurrence
description: Room ownership is decided independently of email invitations.
steps: Receive meeting with start, end and room R
Validate organizer and room policy
Atomically test interval conflicts and reserve room
Store event and accepted attendee state
Send invitations from the committed event version

title: Local recurring time is not a fixed UTC offset
description: Expand recurring occurrences using a timezone identifier and policy.
steps: Weekly meeting is defined as 09:00 Europe-London
The local timezone changes offset at a seasonal boundary
A fixed UTC timestamp would shift the local meeting hour
Recompute occurrences from local rule and timezone data
